description: Levy distribution cumulative distribution function erfc(sqrt(c / (2 (x - mu)))) (location mu, scale c)

tolerance.reason: x, mu and c are exact doubles, c is a power of two and x - mu = c t with t exact on this grid. F = erfc(sqrt u) with u = c / (2 (x - mu)) has condition number about u + 1/2 in u, at most 698 at a normal result on this grid (tested), so rounding u once costs up to 7.8e-14 there (as for gumbel_cdf); a careful method then forms exp(-u) erfcx(sqrt u), which costs a few ulps more (the square root inside erfc would double the loss). 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)
